t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup styled as an engineering drawing sheet on deep navy. A pale hairline border with fine ruler ticks and mono zone references, and white crop-mark brackets at one corner. A large light-weight white sans headline top-left. Below, a few square boxed table blocks in a grid, each with a warm limestone header bar carrying a label and a small mono drawing code, and hairline-ruled rows for <CONTENT>. A title block with mono labels in the bottom-right. Flat, no shading.
signature_idea: Each router column becomes its own drawing-sheet block with a limestone header bar and a mono drawing code, like parts of a title-blocked sheet.
